domain: SELF_GENERATED_A123_EQUIVALENT_SURFACE_TEMPERATURE; NOT MEASURED PACK; NOT PHYSICAL VALIDATION
physics_baseline_relation_to_target: Truth was generated by the same frozen ODE and coefficients used by physics_hold. Future current is held constant in that baseline, rather than supplied from the generator. This is not an independent physics-model validation.
test_first_evidence: Nine tests were executed red before implementation, including group disjointness, gap/no-future processing, outer test perturbation, horizon/current units, and preservation of small errors.
limitations: Deterministic self-generated target from the same fixed ODE as one baseline.
Constant 25 C air gives no ambient-generalization evidence.
Capacity, pack mass and available power vary together in the archived configurations.
Overlapping histories and horizons yield dependent rows; no row-level confidence intervals or significance tests.
Outer temperature/current histories are causal inputs, but outer targets never enter preprocessing, tuning or fitting.
No thermal-runaway forecasting, warning lead time, field false-alarm rate or pack-temperature validation follows from these scores.
